video.learning.title: Sentence learning
video.learning.hint: In the player: ← / → change sentence, R loops, Q pauses at the end. Esc exits fullscreen or closes learning outside fullscreen. Choose assistance, then replay to start; seeking manually releases assistance. Drag the title to move the panel. Editing pins the sentence and keeps your drafts.
video.learning.empty: No timeline yet. Enable original video captions and retry after loading.
video.learning.playFailed: Playback blocked. Use the video play button.
video.learning.enableExplain: Enable AI explanations in selection translation settings first.
video.learning.saved: Saved to the learning center. Repeated saves merge.
video.learning.tooLong: This caption or explanation is too long to save. Shorten the explanation to 2,000 characters; saved source text allows up to 4,096 characters.
video.learning.stopped: Explanation stopped. Edit it or generate it again.
video.learning.drag: Drag the title to move the panel
video.learning.cueEnvelope: Playback uses the original subtitle range; word-level timing is unavailable.
video.learning.segmentationFailed: AI segmentation failed. Current segmentation is retained. You can retry.
video.learning.segmentationDescription: Off by default. Click in the learning panel to send the current passage text only. No audio or video upload. Unavailable in private windows.
video.learning.segmentationServiceDescri: Select a configured AI service explicitly. No translation default or automatic fallback.
video.learning.segmentationModelDescript: Uses this service’s existing credentials. Each click makes one attempt and may incur usage charges.
video.learning.segmentationUnchanged: Analysis complete. No boundary changes needed.
video.learning.segmentationTimeout: Analysis timed out. Current segmentation is retained. You can retry.
video.learning.segmentationPrivate: AI segmentation is unavailable in private windows. Current segmentation is unchanged.
video.learning.segmentationPrivacyUnknow: Window privacy could not be confirmed. AI segmentation is unavailable.
